system.description:
Effect: Until you use a one-hour or longer recovery, when you roll to unlock or lock something, if you roll an 18 or less, treat the roll as an 18. (This means you don’t get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1.) This ability only works on devices that use a key, such as doors, cabinets, treasure chests, and so on.

Genre Items: chime of opening (fantasy); universal locksmith (sci-fi)
